schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The instrument that answers one question per component, mechanically: WHERE IS THE LLM? It walks each component's shipped import closure (composing cairn.tools.import_sieve's reach walk rather than re-deriving it) to the one door that reaches the inference host, and returns a verdict. PURE DETERMINISTIC — no LLM anywhere, not at fire time and not at SLEEP; it may shell out to as many scripts as it likes. MOSTLY DETERMINISTIC — no LLM in the operational loop, but a seam the LLM runs through periodically, at SLEEP, to review feedback and update the deterministic parts. REACHES AN ORACLE — the LLM is in the operational loop, which is correct for the librarian, chat and /chart, and a defect exactly when the thing is a gate. THE SEAMS ARE THE CORPUS'S OWN FILENAMES: `live.py` (the stated LLM edge — librarian/live.py: 'trees.py stays import-pure; this thin edge is where the doors compose') and `nexus.py` (the question-nexus). They are excluded as ENTRY POINTS only — a seam the fire path imports anyway still counts, because then the LLM really is in the loop whatever the file is called. IT ALSO ENFORCES THE ONE ABSOLUTE RULE. Akien, 2026-08-13: 'NO GATES MAY CONSULT ORACLES EVER PERIOD.' Gate-ness is DERIVED — a gate is a component whose own modules DIRECTLY import `cairn.tools.gate`, the primitive holding the == compare over a PROOF RECORD (every check that ran, expected beside actual, passes included) — so the same walk that finds the LLM finds the gates, and a gate that reaches an oracle at fire time OR at SLEEP is a VIOLATION that exits 1 and reds this tool's proof. Direct, not transitive: a gate is what does the compare, not what calls one. SHELL TARGETS ARE REPORTED AND NOT GRADED, and a computed argv is not chased (Akien: 'i don't care about the argv. if it's working, it's working. I never dispermitted shelling... the hope is more and more things become individually callable'). OFF-BOX STATE IS REPORTED, NEVER GRADED — 5432, the trees and the network matter to replayability but psycopg2 is not an LLM, and grading them as oracles is the error the first cut shipped with. The roster is DISK: every directory holding an intention+why.json that ships code. `cairn determinism` is the door; it judges nothing about whether a component OUGHT to be pure, and the disposition is Akien's.
why: Akien, 2026-08-13, verbatim: 'we're sprinting toward akien can inspect the gates and inspectors and find them deterministic and mostly deterministic respectively. I want to SEE that before anything else. That's our base level thing above skills. but it has to be the thing those skills can depend on. I have to SEE that with my own eyes before we move on to anything else.' THE LIVED SYMPTOM: he cannot look at the layer his skills stand on and tell whether it holds. build_inspector's charter has asserted since 2026-07-27 that a gate is 'inference-free by construction ... a gate that consults an oracle is not a gate' and that its verdict is 'always HARDWARE' — a claim about a FIRE PATH that was readable, plausible and unfalsifiable at a glance for seventeen days. Law 3: an unmeasured claim is a hypothesis. Law 9: prose asserting green is not an earning. This walks the path so the claim can be wrong. WHY THE VERDICT IS ABOUT THE LLM AND NOT ABOUT FORKING — Akien's correction the same day, and it is the definition: 'i assume shell means requires running a script. DETERMINISTIC code can call other scripts. But Pure DETERMINISTIC means no LLM calls. So whatever shell scripts it calls can't make LLM calls. MOSTLY means the LLM does not run in the operational loop. But an LLM is called periodically, such as during SLEEP (we do have that idea) to review the feedback and update the deterministic components if needed.' What makes a verdict unreplayable is an oracle in the loop, not a fork.
invoke: `cairn determinism` — the whole report, most-replayable first; `cairn determinism --json` for the machine-readable one; `cairn determinism <root>` to walk a tree other than this repo. import: `from cairn.tools.determinism import determinism`. Prove: `python3 cairn/tools/determinism/proofs/test_determinism.py`.
entry: FRESH build, 2026-08-13, composing import_sieve. Deliberate reuse on the record: the reach walk (`reaches`), the off-box ladder and the mention-vs-capability mesh belong to import_sieve and are imported, not copied (Law 1, I-borrow-patterns-cite-dont-graft). Re-deriving reach here would re-earn the two failures import_sieve's header records — a docstring's honest mention of inference_domain firing a grep, and a port number in an error string doing the same.
state_and_history: state.json + history.json beside this charter, BORN AT THIS ADDRESS'S FIRST CROSSING. Until a ticket crosses here there is no journal, and that absence is this component's ordinary resting state rather than a missing file — a component that has never sailed has no voyage to record. CORRECTED 2026-08-20 (ticket a-charter-may-not-assert-a-file-that-is-not-there).
how_it_learns: FROM THE GAP BETWEEN ITS VERDICT AND AKIEN'S. It emits a verdict per component and judges no component wrong, so a disagreement is always visible as his correction rather than as a silent pass — and it has already been corrected three times, each landing as physics rather than as a comment. (1) IT WAS BUILT ON THE WRONG AXIS. The first cut graded on 'does it leave the process', which made a `git` call disqualifying and reported 17 components as reaching an oracle when not one of them could reach the inference host. Akien re-cut it onto the LLM; tooth (b) is now a permanent trap for the old reading. (2) IT COLLAPSED THE FIRE PATH INTO THE LEARNING SEAM and reported build_inspector — THE gate — as consulting an oracle; the split is now physics, and tooth (g) pins the inverse so a filename cannot launder an oracle. (3) IT NAMED A COLUMN `GATES` when what it measures is a declared refusal class, which build_inspector's fire path does not have at all; narrowed to `REFUSES`. (4) IT COULD NOT RED THE THING HE CARED ABOUT. It reported where every LLM was and then had to admit gate-ness lived in prose, so it could not enforce 'no gate consults an oracle'. Akien ruled the gate's SHAPE rather than the reporting mechanism, and the shape berthed as `cairn/tools/gate/`; gate-ness is now an import fact and the rule is a walk. Its own first run then caught the over-match — reading gate-ness transitively made skills/chart a gate — which is tooth (l2).
filed_edges: (a) CLOSED 2026-08-13, the same day it was filed, and NOT the way it was filed. The edge said a gate must DECLARE itself in a charter field. Akien ruled the rule instead of the mechanism ('NO GATES MAY CONSULT ORACLES EVER PERIOD. A GATE ONLY OPENS WHEN A FINDINGS REPORT MATCHES WHAT IT ALLOWS. ITS AN == compare'), which made a better mechanism available: berth the compare as `cairn/tools/gate/` and gate-ness becomes an IMPORT FACT this tool already knows how to walk. A declared field would have been a value stranded in a human's head, stale in the safe direction; an import cannot lie about itself. The residue: only components that COMPOSE the primitive are gates, so a gate written longhand — as build_inspector's `not findings` was until today — is invisible until it is rewired.

(b) A SHELLED BINARY THAT ITSELF CALLS AN LLM IS INVISIBLE, and it stays open by ruling. Akien, 2026-08-13: 'i don't care about the argv. if it's working, it's working. I never dispermitted shelling. since we're trying to push compilation downward, the hope is more and more things become individually callable.' The second cut chased computed argv and flagged five components *UNPROVEN, which dressed the system's own goal up as a debt. Shell targets are reported as evidence of that compilation pushing downward; nothing is graded or flagged. Tooth (c) keeps the debt register from coming back.

(d) `learning/` SITS ON NO RUNG. Found by this tool's own first run: a component with a charter and code at the repo root, born 2026-07-17, missed by the big-bang reorg — it reports rung '?'. Not moved here; a berth move is its own crossing.

(e) NO SECOND CONSUMER YET. The report is read by Akien and by this component's proofs. It exits 1 on a gate violation and its proof reds the corpus for one, so the RULE is now enforced; the rest of the report is still an instrument nobody but Akien reads, and the record does not dress it as more.

(g) ONE GATE ON THE ROSTER. `cairn/machines/build_inspector` is the only component composing the primitive, so tooth (q)'s non-vacuity check passes by exactly one. Every other gate in the system — the derivation gate, the ruling intake's refusals, the emit chokepoint, the tester — still decides with longhand code, and is therefore not held to the rule. Rewiring them is the work; until it is done, 'no gate consults an oracle' is enforced over a set of one and this says so. SHARPENED 2026-08-13, same day: the one gate on the roster now emits a PROOF RECORD rather than a findings list (Akien: 'EVERYTHING ALWAYS PROVED AND LISTING WHAT IT PROVED. SAME PATTERN EVERYWHERE'), so the set of one is at least the right shape for the others to be rewired TO. This tool is itself on that list — `determinism` reports its gate_violations and says nothing about the checks that passed, which is the same silence it exists to catch elsewhere.

(f) SLEEP IS A CONCEPT WITH ONE MENTION. Akien: 'an LLM is called periodically, such as during SLEEP (we do have that idea)'. The corpus mentions it once (MAP.md:1042, 'the sleep consolidation is the same — a probe the PROVED graze sets'). This tool now names the MOSTLY band after it, which is more weight than the concept currently carries anywhere else.
gates: proof gate — proofs/test_determinism.py under the tester (18 teeth, incl. (q): gates must EXIST before 'none consults an oracle' is asserted, and (l2): calling a gate does not make you one). Durability gate: committed + pushed.
falsifier: RED on any of: (1) a component whose closure provably reaches inference_domain is reported PURE; (2) a component that reaches no LLM is reported as reaching one (a report that reds everything gets ignored, which is the failure mode of a scan nobody trusts); (3) a shell-out costs a component its purity — Akien's correction, armed as tooth (b); (4) off-box state (psycopg2, the trees) sets a verdict instead of being reported beside it; (5) a SLEEP seam's LLM reach is counted against the fire path, or is silently dropped instead of reported; (6) a seam reachable FROM the fire path is excused because of its filename; (7) the roster misses a component that holds a charter and ships code, or invents one that does not exist; (8) a clean-looking report over a tree it never read (the hollow floor — Law 8). WRONG-SHAPE SIGNAL: if the verdict stops changing when components genuinely move, the roster has quietly become a list.
proof: proofs/test_determinism.py — the three verdicts pinned on synthetic components with known reach, each paired against a tree that must NOT produce it; shelling-out pinned as costing nothing (Akien's correction); an opaque argv pinned as flagged rather than assumed innocent; off-box reach pinned as reported-not-graded; the seam split pinned in both directions; the hollow floor refusing an unread tree; the real corpus by invariant, never by snapshot count, including this tool's own purity.
owner: A TOOL HAS USERS, NOT AN OWNER (Law 6). Whatever state it comes to carry berths under its holder and is the holder's to gate, so there is nothing of its OWN to gate (ruling 2026-08-14-tools-and-machines-remember-under-their-holder). CC writes the code and proofs; Akien owns the design — the definition of the three verdicts (which he corrected onto the LLM axis on the day it was born) and the disposition of what the report shows.
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured — this converts a seventeen-day-old prose claim into a walk)
Law 9 (red is the default, green is earned — an assertion of inference-freedom is not an earning)
Law 4 (a rule enforced by physics; today this is the measurement, and edge (a) is the honest IOU for the enforcement)
Law 1 (the reach walk lives once, in import_sieve)
I-nexi-everywhere (fire paths are hardware; the seam is where the oracle belongs)
